title: B13 - Passive: All Tenses
essence: Пассивный залог можно образовать в любом времени — формула одна: форма глагола BE (меняется по временам) + V3 (всегда третья форма). Present: is/are done. Past: was/were done. Future: will be done. Present Perfect: has/have been done. Past Perfect: had been done. Present Continuous: is/are being done. Главное — правильно определить время глагола BE.
formula:
Universal formula: BE (в нужном времени) + V3

Present Simple: is/are + V3
Past Simple: was/were + V3
Future Simple: will be + V3
Present Perfect: have/has been + V3
Past Perfect: had been + V3
Present Continuous: am/is/are being + V3
Past Continuous: was/were being + V3
Future Perfect: will have been + V3
dontConfuse: Ошибаются во времени глагола BE: «The house was building» (неверно, время не то и форма не та) вместо «The house is being built» (Present Continuous Passive). Также забывают been в Perfect Passive: «The work has finished» (актив) vs «The work has been finished» (пассив). И не отличают «is done» (факт) от «is being done» (в процессе).

examples.en: The new hospital will be opened next year.
examples.ru: Новая больница будет открыта в следующем году.

examples.note: Present Perfect Passive: have been + V3

examples.en: The road is being repaired this week.
examples.note: Present Continuous Passive: is being + V3

examples.en: The project had been completed before the deadline.
examples.note: Past Perfect Passive: had been + V3

examples.en: The cake was being decorated when I arrived.
examples.note: Past Continuous Passive: was being + V3
